consts.name: dlbGajinScrollPct
consts.comment: the gajin scroll percent - the 5% of all scrolls found containing gajin spells (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbUseStandardDMGRules
bools.comment: the type determination - use the standard rules given in the DMG for the type of scroll found (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbMagicUsersAsWuJen
bools.comment: the first mapping - treating magic-users as wu jen (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbClericsAsShukenja
bools.comment: the second mapping - treating clerics as shukenja (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbGajinSpellsFivePct
bools.comment: the gajin spells - the 5% of all scrolls found containing gajin spells, either magic-user or clerical (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbGajinUsedByWuJenShukenja
bools.comment: the usability - such spells usable by wu jen and shukenja respectively (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbGajinAddedToSpellBooks
bools.comment: the spell books - the gajin spells even addable to the spell books in the case of the wu jen (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbProtectionFromDevilsRerolled
bools.comment: the protection from devils scroll - not commonly found in Oriental lands, the result rerolled (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbProtectionFromShapechangersScope
bools.comment: the protection from shapechangers scroll - including all hengeyokai and the spirit creatures able to change their form (print capture p. 288)

bools.name: dlbProtectionFromUndeadRerolled
bools.comment: the protection from undead scroll - not commonly found in Oriental lands, the result rerolled (print capture p. 288)
